rules: Occupation changes effective control only where forces can actually sustain it.
Occupation does not automatically transfer sovereignty, claim recognition or population loyalty.
Blockade requires real force presence/capability and a defined access area.
Blockade effectiveness can vary; it is not a magical system-wide switch.
Civilian administration, resistance and collaboration require their own actual World State.
Withdrawal or defeat can end effective occupation while territorial claims persist separately.
Political-space overlays consume validated control/occupation changes.
